description: Find a screen OODS Foundry generated at the pinned version: object and context pick one of the recorded object screens, and framework its React or Vue app. Returns the URL on oods-foundry.com where that built app runs, its recorded content hash, the brand and theme it was generated in, and the three local calls that reproduce it (brand_create, design_compose, code_generate). Nothing is composed or generated here; for a live preview of your own composition, call design_preview over local stdio. Use object_registry show instead to read the definition behind a screen.
name: design_preview
title: Look Up Recorded Screen
